pressures.nonclaim: in-memory closed JS objects are covered; a duplicate-key-aware byte parser and cross-language golden bytes are not

pressures.covered: block insert/delete/move/attribute, text insert/delete, operation-scoped atom ids, delete wins, and deterministic move-cycle breaking
forward, reverse, interleaved, duplicated, and reconstructed delivery of the retained corpus

pressures.blocker: mark affinity, endpoint repair, grapheme UI behavior, undo, and a Notion/Docs-style editor are absent
no generated document declaration, durable operation table, uniqueness settlement, or ordinary live invalidation exists
no retained snapshot/frontier/outbox, authority-bound replay, resynchronization, or quarantine exists
no executable document-wide owner/editor/commenter/viewer admission witness exists
revision history, comments, orphan anchors, and LLP 0013 document-room presence are absent
stable-frontier compaction, anchor skeletons, fencing, backup, and restore verification are absent
2 MiB/10,000-block windowing and preregistered memory, latency, storage-amplification, and fan-out instruments are absent
server, web, Exact Native iOS, and Exact Native Android reducer tuples do not yet share this corpus
LLP 0068 remains Draft pending independent review and maintainer ratification
